evidence: Evidence defines every module boundary: IFC input (D5), work-item catalogue with units and resource lines (D1), lifecycle-separated GWP (D3), planned networks and calendars as structural examples (D4, D6). The gaps (crew, calendars, revisions, ML labels) are known and can be represented as user inputs and optional modules. Section A adds verified IFC inputs; Agent 2 architecture package exists (research/architecture/stage5_0/).

Section A: authored volumes/areas in SCH design and RST; geometry agrees with authored volume on 251/251 elements; units declared in all key models (0 explicit quantity unit overrides); mass in GRAM in SCH. Missing: reinforcement (D), formwork rules (C), excavation/backfill site data (C/D), independent manual quantity checks (plan issued, not executed).

D1 supplies RC work items with units (m3/m2/kg) matching IFC quantity types; D5 shows element-to-phase assignment. No source supplies element-level task mappings or RC dependency rules, so generation must be rule-based and engineer-approved. Condition: documented rule set reviewed by a PMI user. Section A: one real element-to-task reference (SCH Synchro, 3,505 elements / 125 tasks) for checking generated packages; not a training set.

Person-h/unit for 17 of 18 targets (D1, catalogue estimates, Andalucia). Missing: crew sizes, daily working hours, productivity adjustments, curing/striking times. Condition: these values entered and approved by a PMI user per project; outputs labelled as catalogue-based estimates.

OR-Tools 9.15.6755 is installed in .venv-planning (Python 3.12.14). Dependency, calendar and resource data exist only as foreign examples (D4 Qld, D6 BE). Condition: user-supplied calendar, crew availability and RC sequencing rules; no learned dependencies. Section A: SCH Synchro IFC2X3 export gives an IFC4D read-back reference (tasks, IfcRelSequence, assignments); no resources in any IFC.

No acquired dataset contains, for the same activity, an actual duration and the quantity + productivity + crew inputs required to compute an engineering duration in compatible units. D4 actuals are cost-account level and civil; D6/D7 lack quantities; D5 lacks durations. Target y=log(actual/engineering) cannot be computed without unlinked merging. Section A: no IFC-linked actual activity durations (RST finish-only, retrospectively entered; SCH none).

Cost coefficients: D1 direct unit costs reproduce exactly (Andalucia, EUR, mixed concept dates). Environmental: D3 A1-A3/A4/A5 GWP for concrete, steel, timber, transport, electricity, site processes. Condition: keep modules and A1/A2 standards separate, fill formwork/diesel gaps or exclude them, and report geographic mismatch.
